confidenceRubric: CONFIDENCE (envelope): HIGH = every claim is backed by evidence read or executed in this call; MEDIUM = some claims rest on inference or unread context; LOW = mostly inference or incomplete evidence. Never HIGH when STATUS is PARTIAL.
receiptGate: Before relying on any receipt, read STATUS, CONFIDENCE, COVERAGE (when present) and GAPS. PARTIAL, COVERAGE: partial, or non-empty GAPS become a PENDING item (risk or blocked). A receipt missing an envelope field is unverified: re-request it once, then report it.
handoff: A finding tagged [handoff:sentinel] in an assayer receipt triggers sentinel for that scope, even when no other {trigger} trigger fired.
